title: Ranh giới dịch vụ và HTTP
requirements: Two independent Catalog/Orders processes communicate through HTTP; Orders owns snapshots and integer-cent totals.
Validate input and bounded payloads, distinguish dependency outage/timeout, use real HTTP integration tests.

title: Hợp đồng API và tương thích phiên bản
requirements: Build an independently runnable Catalog/Orders lesson with GET /v1/products/:id and a different nested-price /v2/products/:id schema; Orders continues consuming v1.
A pure runtime v1-product parser accepts additive unknown response fields but rejects missing/wrong-type/id/price fields; write meaningful unit fixtures first.

Prove compatibility with additive provider fields and rejection of incompatible upstream data over real HTTP with separate provider/consumer processes. Explain that TypeScript alone does not validate network JSON.

title: Dữ liệu thuộc từng dịch vụ
requirements: Use built-in node:sqlite for separate service-owned SQLite files under configurable temporary/data paths; never share a database file between services.
Demonstrate an order surviving Orders restart and retrieval without the Catalog dependency; use real processes and independent temp database paths per test.
Document schema/migration initialization, ownership boundaries and SQLite single-node tradeoffs, without claiming a production deployment.

title: Truyền deadline và hủy yêu cầu
requirements: Go beyond lesson01 single-hop timeout: propagate a bounded end-to-end remaining deadline through Gateway→Orders→Catalog.
Use AbortController and validated deadline metadata; cancel downstream work when the caller disconnects or the budget expires.
Unit-test budget calculations with an injected clock; use real service processes and synchronization/barriers to verify cancellation without brittle sleep-based assertions.

title: Tạo đơn có idempotency
requirements: Implement an Idempotency-Key contract for order creation with persistent service-owned SQLite records and a request fingerprint.
Concurrent identical requests return the same order; a reused key with different input returns409; a completed response can be replayed after restart.
Test real concurrent HTTP requests, conflict cases, input validation and restart recovery; explain failures still requiring recovery rather than asserting exactly-once networking.

title: Retry có giới hạn và backoff
requirements: Implement bounded retry policy with exponential backoff and jitter for transient safe/idempotent operations only, respecting the overall deadline.
Pure policy tests use deterministic RNG/clock; real HTTP tests make an upstream fail twice then succeed and prove exact bounded attempts.
Do not retry arbitrary POST requests blindly; compare safe GET and a request protected by an idempotency contract.

title: Circuit breaker và half-open
requirements: Build an explicit closed/open/half-open state machine around a downstream HTTP dependency; bound the half-open probe count.
Unit-test state/time transitions with an injected clock; integration-test fast failures while open and recovery after a successful probe.
Explain circuit breaker versus timeout/retry and document the scope/limits of per-instance state.

title: Correlation ID và log có cấu trúc
requirements: Propagate a validated correlation/request ID between independent HTTP services, using generated IDs for absent/invalid input.
Emit structured JSON logs without request secrets and demonstrate tracing one request across services.
Test interleaved requests for context isolation and actual propagated HTTP headers/log records; explain logs are not a full distributed tracing system.

title: API gateway và kết quả một phần
requirements: Build a gateway that concurrently aggregates two independently owned downstream resources through HTTP, without database sharing.
Set bounded per-dependency/overall deadlines and specify an explicit partial-result contract versus total failure.
Test healthy, single-dependency failure, total failure and input validation with real separate processes; avoid a gateway that reimplements all business logic.

title: Readiness và graceful shutdown
requirements: Extend beyond basic listener close: implement a draining state that rejects new business requests, reports readiness false, and lets in-flight work finish before a bounded exit.
Use a local lifecycle implementation if root shared helper semantics do not fit; do not modify root helpers.
Unit-test lifecycle transitions and integration-test SIGTERM with synchronized in-flight requests and eventual process exit; distinguish liveness and readiness.

title: Transactional outbox và giao nhận ít nhất một lần
requirements: Use a service-owned SQLite transaction to atomically store a business change and an outbox event.
Deliver events to another service over an explicitly documented HTTP transport with retries and an idempotent consumer; do not claim to implement Kafka or exactly-once delivery.
Test receiver outage, duplicate delivery and producer restart recovery with separate service processes and durable temp files.

title: Saga và hành động bù trừ
requirements: Build a small durable orchestrated saga coordinating simulated Inventory and Payment services over HTTP, without any real payment/network integration.
Document forward and compensating operations, idempotency and explicit recovery from failed compensation.
Test success, payment refusal, compensation and restart recovery using independent processes; do not call local compensation a distributed ACID transaction.

title: Bulkhead và cô lập tải giữa các dependency
requirements: Build an independently runnable gateway and two downstream HTTP services with separate bounded per-dependency concurrency pools; reject excess work promptly with an explicit 503 contract rather than an unbounded queue.

Unit-test admission, idempotent release, configuration validation and release after success, errors and cancellation; acquire capacity before starting downstream work and always release it in finally.

Use real independent processes and synchronization barriers to fill one dependency pool, prove rejected calls never reach that dependency, and prove the other dependency remains usable; verify capacity returns after failure and deadline cancellation. Explain per-instance scope and distinguish bulkheads from circuit breakers and rate limits.

title: Rate limiting bằng token bucket
requirements: Build an independently runnable gateway and downstream service; use a token bucket per validated bounded demonstration client ID, explicit capacity/refill configuration, and HTTP 429 with a positive integer Retry-After when the client exhausts its budget. Reject before forwarding and never present an untrusted demo header as authentication.

Use an injected monotonic clock for deterministic unit tests covering initial burst, refill boundaries, retry delay rounding, invalid configuration and client isolation. Bound client-tracking memory with a documented full-capacity policy; idle expiry may remove only buckets that would already have fully refilled, so eviction cannot reset a depleted client's quota.

Use real independent HTTP processes to prove exact admitted/rejected requests through downstream counters, client isolation, validation and Retry-After responses. Explain per-instance limits, process restart resets, replica multiplication and why rate limiting does not bound concurrent slow requests.

title: CQRS và read model nhất quán cuối cùng
requirements: Build independent Orders command and query/read-model processes with separate service-owned SQLite files. Orders atomically persists business state and durable event records; synchronize a query-optimized order summary over bounded HTTP requests without sharing database files or importing previous lessons.

Apply events and durable deduplication/checkpoint state atomically at the read model; define event IDs, per-order versions and explicit duplicate, conflicting and stale/out-of-order event contracts. Explain an explicit strategy for gaps rather than silently advancing past missing data.

Write meaningful pure policy or in-memory SQLite unit tests first. With real service processes, durable temporary files and synchronization barriers, prove observable stale reads while propagation is paused, eventual convergence, duplicate/version handling and producer/consumer restart recovery without double-counting. Document source-of-truth ownership, freshness metadata, bounded failures and why CQRS neither requires event sourcing nor guarantees immediate read-your-writes.
